dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Wáng shī fu, nín lái de zhēn zǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Hái yǒu jǐ gè xiāng zi méi hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Mā ma, wǒ lái bāng nǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yě lái! xiāng zi zài nǎr?

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Zài zhè lǐ, xiān kàn zhè ge ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè shì chú fáng de xiāng zi.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Bú duì, lǐ miàn shì shū.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Nà shì wǒ de shū!

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: A, shì wǒ fàng de.

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Méi shì, ná chū lái jiù hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, bǎ shū gěi jiě jie.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Yǔ tóng, nǐ de xiāng zi zài nàr.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Kàn dào le, zài mén páng biān.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Jiě jie, zhè běn yě shì nǐ de?
dialogues.tr: Abla, bu kitap da mı senin?

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiǎo xīn, shū bié diào le.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǐ ná zhe.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè běn shì bà ba de.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Nà bà ba de shū fàng zhè biān.
dialogues.tr: Öyleyse babamın kitaplarını bu tarafa koyalım.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ de shū zhǐ yǒu yī běn.

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Yī běn yě yào dài shàng a.
dialogues.tr: Bir kitap da olsa yanımıza alalım.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ de nà běn zài nǎr?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Shì bú shì zài fáng jiān lǐ?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ gāng cái kàn jiàn le, zài zhuō shàng.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Duì! wǒ hái méi ná.

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Qù ná ba, wǒ děng nǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè ge xiǎo xiāng zi shì kōng de.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Chú fáng de bēi zi fàng lǐ miàn ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Mā ma, bēi zi zài zhè lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ ná yí gè, kě yǐ ma?

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Kě yǐ, màn yì diǎn.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Bié ná tài duō, lè le.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiè xiè, fàng zhè lǐ jiù hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Hái yǒu zhè ge bái sè de bēi zi.
dialogues.tr: Bir de şu beyaz bardak var.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè shì mā ma de, wǒ zhī dào.

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo le, zhè ge xiāng zi kě yǐ le.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Wáng shī fu, zhè ge wǒ lái ná.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Děng děng, māo zài nǎr?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Mī mī? gāng cái hái zài zhè lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ tīng jiàn le, zài xiāng zi lǐ!

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān bié bān, wǒ men kàn kàn.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Mī mī, nǐ yě xiǎng bān jiā a?
dialogues.tr: Mimi, sen de mi taşınmak istiyorsun?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Tā xǐ huan zhè ge xiǎo xiāng zi.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Kàn, tā de tóu chū lái le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Mī mī, lái wǒ zhè lǐ!

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Bié jí, ràng tā zì jǐ chū lái.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Tā chū lái le, xiāng zi kōng le.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Yǔ tóng, māo bāo ná lái le ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Ná lái le, jiù zài wǒ páng biān.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Mī mī jīn tiān yě zuò huǒ chē ma?
dialogues.tr: Mimi de bugün trene mi binecek?

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Māo de shì, nǐ men wèn bà ba ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ men dōu qù xīn jiā.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiān ràng mī mī jìn māo bāo.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ zài zhè biān bāng nǐ kàn zhe.
dialogues.tr: Ben bu tarafta göz kulak olayım.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Jìn qù la! tā hěn guāi.

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè yàng jiù bú huì zǒu diū le.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, nǐ de shū ne?

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Gāng cái shuō yào ná, ná le ma?
dialogues.tr: Az önce alacağını söyledin, aldın mı?

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Tā hái zài kàn māo ne.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Āi yā, wǒ wàng le!

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Shū bié wàng, māo yě bié wàng.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ péi nǐ qù fáng jiān kàn kàn.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhuō shàng de dōng xi dōu yào ná.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Hái yǒu nǐ de hóng sè xiǎo chē.
dialogues.tr: Bir de kırmızı oyuncak araban var.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Zhǎo dào le, shū zài xiǎo chē xià miàn.

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè huí dōu zhǎo dào le ba?

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Dōu zhǎo dào le, xiè xiè nín.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiǎo chē fàng zài nǐ de bāo lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Shū fàng zhè ge xiāng zi lǐ ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.zh: 好了，我的东西都在这儿。
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo le, wǒ de dōng xi dōu zài zhèr.

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Nà wǒ xiān bān zhè ge xiāng zi.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Mén wǒ lái kāi, nín màn diǎn.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Hái zi men, bié zhàn zài mén kǒu.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ men zhàn zài zhè lǐ jiù hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Bà ba, zhè ge dà xiāng zi hǎo zhòng.
dialogues.tr: Baba, şu büyük kutu çok ağır.

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhòng de wǒ lái, nǐ ná xiǎo de.
dialogues.tr: Ağır olanı ben taşıyayım, sen küçüğü al.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Lè le, tīng wáng shī fu de.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.zh: 水在厨房，大家喝一点吧。
dialogues.pinyin: Shuǐ zài chú fáng, dà jiā hē yì diǎn ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ qù ná bēi zi.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Mā ma, wǒ yě xiǎng hē shuǐ.
dialogues.tr: Anne, ben de su içmek istiyorum.

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Xiè xiè, wǒ hē yī xiǎo bēi jiù hǎo.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Bān jiā hái zhēn yǒu diǎn lèi.
dialogues.actionTr: Su içerken kısa bir nefes alır.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Hē le shuǐ, zài kàn kàn fáng jiān.
dialogues.tr: Suyu içelim, sonra odaya bir daha bakalım.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ de fáng jiān dōu kōng le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Jiě jie, nǐ bù kāi xīn ma?

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhù le hěn jiǔ, shě bù dé ba.
dialogues.tr: Uzun zamandır burada oturdunuz, ayrılmak zor geliyordur.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 我们以后还会来看看的。
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ men yǐ hòu hái huì lái kàn kàn de.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Xīn jiā yě huì hěn hǎo de.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Èn, wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn xīn fáng jiān.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ yào hé mī mī yì qǐ kàn!

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Nǐ men huì xǐ huan xīn jiā de.

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.pinyin: Zuì hòu zài kàn yī biàn ba.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Chú fáng lǐ méi yǒu dōng xi le.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.pinyin: Fáng jiān lǐ yě méi yǒu le.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Mén páng biān hái yǒu yí gè bāo!
dialogues.tr: Kapının yanında bir çanta daha var!

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.pinyin: Zhè ge yě fàng chē shàng ma?

dialogues.speaker: 张伟
dialogues.zh: 不用，这个包我们自己拿。
dialogues.pinyin: Bù yòng, zhè ge bāo wǒ men zì jǐ ná.
dialogues.tr: Gerek yok, bu çantayı biz yanımıza alacağız.

dialogues.speaker: 刘梅
dialogues.pinyin: Huǒ chē piào dōu zài zhè ge bāo lǐ.

dialogues.speaker: 张雨桐
dialogues.zh: 妈妈，那我们先看看票吧。
dialogues.pinyin: Mā ma, nà wǒ men xiān kàn kàn piào ba.

dialogues.speaker: 张乐乐
dialogues.pinyin: Wǒ lái zhǎo wǒ de nà zhāng!

dialogues.speaker: 王师傅
dialogues.zh: 好，你们看，我再数数箱子。
dialogues.pinyin: Hǎo, nǐ men kàn, wǒ zài shǔ shu xiāng zi.
dialogues.tr: Tamam, siz bakın, ben de kutuları tekrar sayayım.
